descriptionLong: Discover a new world in photography. With our folding light box for product photography, you can quickly and easily illuminate any object that fits inside. Easy and fast assembly, in less than 1 minute you will have a photo studio to use with both your mobile phone and a professional camera. It has a strip of LED light on the front tab, which will perfectly illuminate your product in a soft and diffuse way, perfecting texture and shadows. It has two interchangeable bottoms, one white and one black. Its material and matte finish absorb the light avoiding uncomfortable reflections and allowing a clean and impeccable finish. Once folded it takes up very little space, and you can store it in the non woven carrying bag that includes the pack. It also includes a micro-USB and USB power cable, which you can connect to a power adapter or even an external battery to take it anywhere (not included).
